Moving from the old website? Export a JSON backup there and import it here. Browsers keep each website’s local data separate.

📤 Export your data

Download a JSON backup of your signed-in account’s ideas, plans, posting history, and reminder preferences.

📥 Import data

Import a backup exported from version 1 or version 2. This replaces the content in your signed-in account after confirmation.

🗑 Clear all data

Permanently delete all your ideas, plans, and streak history. This cannot be undone — export first!
